text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Now then, I'll teach you the secret to 
Push the Rock~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Wait, Bright, you know about wrestling? 
Since when...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. Actually, I did a bit of that 
before as special stamina-building 
training for the autumn long-distance 
races~. I'm glad that experience came in 
handy~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Well then, here I go. Facing the track, 
taking a deep breath, gathering my 
focus...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Howaaaa~~~ Hawaaa~~~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
H-Huh...? That cheer is oddly soothing, 
isn't it... Hey Bright, are you okay—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Howaaaa~~... Hawawa~~ Eeeeeei.
(SKRRRRRR...!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? It moved...!? Why did it react to 
that chant!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
It's strange... but then again, it's 
Bright. That soft, airy breathing of hers 
must be where the secret lies, I'm sure of 
it...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yes, indeed~ By settling your breathing, 
all soft and gentle like, your power just 
naturally wells up~

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I-I see...? Maybe I should give it a shot 
too...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, now let's do it together~. Howaaa~ 
Hawaaa~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Howaa, hawaaa~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Heeei-yah!
(SKRRRRRRRRRR!!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: ...!! I-It worked...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my! You moved nearly twice as much as 
I did~! As expected of you, Big Sister 
Ryan~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Ryan's amazing, but... Bright's quite 
impressive too. It actually functions 
properly as a breathing technique.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! This breathing technique is 
seriously amazing! Dober, you should try 
it too!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huh!? No, um, I'm a bit...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"It's not so much that I'm holding back, 
more like... it's just embarrassing..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"Oh my, please don't be shy~. When you 
feel all warm and fuzzy like this, your 
strength naturally wells right up, so 
please do experience it for yourself~."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Now, everyone together: yaaawn~

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Howaa~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: H-Hwaa...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
~~gh, impossible!! I'm so embarrassed all 
my strength is draining away...!
